text.p: Unichem Plc said on Monday that its retail pharmacy chain E. Moss Ltd had acquired five chemists shops for a consideration not exceeding 3.54 million stg.
The combined turnover of the pharmacies for the year to December 1996 stood at 4.89 million stg.
Unichem said the consideration would be financed through the issue of 31,471 UniChem ordinary shares at 2.54 stg each with the balance paid in cash.
Unichem said the acquisitions brought the total of Moss Chemists stores to 457 in England, Scotland and Wales.
Unichem said last month that it would continue to build up its pharmacy chain on a piecemeal basis following its failure to gain control of the 900-strong Lloyds Chemists Plc chain.
Unichem lost a year-long takeover battle with its German rival Gehe AG.
